purpose: Create transparent, reproducible future parameter scenarios for candidate comparison; these are modeling assumptions, not forecasts.
decision_timing: One fixed 2024-2030 planting plan is chosen before uncertain outcomes are known. Adaptive yearly re-planning is excluded from the trial and may be used only as a later information upper-bound diagnostic.

normal_sales_base.main: Use Q1 D05 seasonal allocation of the 2023 production proxy as the working baseline.
normal_sales_base.warning: No observed sales column exists. D05 is a transparent midpoint allocation convention, not a measured market quantity.

sale_rule.optimization_main: S2: production above normal-sales capacity is sold at 50% of that scenario-year normal price
sale_rule.stress_test: S1: excess production has zero revenue
sale_rule.warning: Q2 does not explicitly select one Q1 disposal rule; this convention requires A-point approval.

random_mechanism.independence: Q2 trial treats crop-year drivers as independent; correlation and substitution/complementarity are reserved for Q3
random_mechanism.wheat_corn_sales: annual growth draw 5%/7.5%/10%, compounded from the previous year
random_mechanism.other_crop_sales: annual multiplier -5%/0%/+5% relative to the 2023 baseline, not a random walk
random_mechanism.yield: crop-year multiplier -10%/0%/+10% around the frozen yield; shared across eligible land types for that crop-year
random_mechanism.cost: main path compounds 5% per year; 4% and 6% deterministic sensitivity paths
random_mechanism.grain_price: constant at the frozen midpoint candidate
random_mechanism.vegetable_price: main path compounds 5% per year; 4% and 6% deterministic sensitivity paths

comparison.use: A-to-B candidate comparison; not used to fit or tune

stress.construction: named combinations of low demand, low yield, high cost and adverse prices
stress.use: M3 optimization and all-candidate stress reporting

future_holdout.use: reserved for post-B deepening; must not be opened during trial

required_outputs_before_any_model_claim: scenario table with every sampled multiplier and source rule
proof that training and comparison seeds/files differ
